Registry materialization uses BulkArm: ONE MechanismRegistry.replace() of all 5 inherited mechanisms (single write) instead of 5 sequential upsert() read+rewrite cycles. Timed per episode (t_reuse) in parity order against cold episodes; arg deepcopy of the full mech dict stays inside the inclusive timed boundary (same operand as the parent reuse arm), with the S-ARG-subtracted NOARG boundary as gated co-decider (both must show robust reuse wins at both L on every class). Gated breadth is n=5 (full set) only; no diagnostic breadth episodes are run in v6 (smallest decisive batch; breadth scaling already recorded ungated in the parent).

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, N=36 valid trials. functional_ok := repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 (over 144 unaffected probes per class, 432 total) AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80 (same bars as the parent packet; at N=36 a perfect 36/36 record gives Wilson lower ~0.9036, so the 0.60 bar is looser in absolute terms but unchanged as a rule). For each of 12 cells (class x L in {2,3} x boundary in {inclusive, NOARG}): R := median(reuse_episode_s)/median(cold_episode_s); BFCI := family-wise Bonferroni bootstrap CI at level 1-0.05/12 (B=10000, frozen seeds) with 95% CI (B=2000) reported as diagnostic. Cell verdict: UNKNOWN if R or BFCI missing; WIN if R<1.00 AND BFCI_upper<1.00; LOSS if R>=1.00 AND BFCI_lower>=1.00; else MARGINAL. Class verdict (first match): FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; COST-UNKNOWN if any cell UNKNOWN; PRICED-DEFICIT if any LOSS; PRICED-WIN if all WIN; else PRICED-MARGINAL. Aggregate (first match): FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL if any class FUNCTIONAL-FAIL; INCONCLUSIVE if any class COST-UNKNOWN; PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED if any class PRICED-DEFICIT; SUPPORTS if all classes PRICED-WIN; else INCONCLUSIVE (marginal straddle: no re-admit, no permanent drop, thread PARKED per the mandate stop trigger -- this N is the last budgeted resolution attempt and a second consecutive straddle funds no third). Any tripped validity gate (V0..V15, V-DRIFT-*, V-REG-EQUIV, V-TIMING) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (status; outcome INCONCLUSIVE; never a negative). Strict inequality throughout: 1.00 is never a win. All five aggregates {SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED, FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE-via-UNKNOWN, INCONCLUSIVE-via-MARGINAL} plus MEASUREMENT_INVALID are demonstrated reachable by pure synthetic probes at DESIGN.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. No calibration workload. 108 trials x (2 warmups + 3 timed episodes + literal + norepair controls) on an in-process localhost server plus NC trials: ~30-120 minutes wall clock (parent ran 36 trials x 5 timed episodes; v6 runs 3x trials but only 3 timed episodes per trial, so ~1.8x parent wall-clock), negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency. B3 model economics unsatisfiable on this substrate by construction; priced in counters only with the blocker recorded. Bootstrap B_BONF=10000 over n=36 medians is trivial pure computation (120k resampled medians per seed family, deterministic under frozen seeds).
expected_information_gain: Terminal and decision-changing in every branch; this packet executes the exact larger-N resolution the parent verdict, the parent audit (AF-7: L2 margin unresolvable at n=12, fail-safe parks instead of deciding) and the Global Research Director mandate prescribe, and FORCES the re-admission vs permanent-drop vs park resolution the parent explicitly left pending (parent: 8 WIN / 4 MARGINAL, no re-admission, no permanent drop). N=36 narrows the parent +/-6% family-wise half-widths by sqrt(12/36)~0.577 to a projected ~3.0-3.9%, sufficient to convert a true |R-1| effect of ~5% or larger into a robust WIN or LOSS with margin (~4% at the resolution boundary); a true effect below ~3% remains a straddle and PARKs the thread per the mandate stop trigger (second consecutive straddle funds no third attempt). SUPPORTS (all 12 cells robust reuse wins with valid gates) completes the 12-cell bar and re-admits localized repair to C-PRODUCT-ECON with honest denominators; any robust LOSS cell makes the drop permanent and stops the thread (bounded stop, licensed because the known removable tax was removed by measurement in the parent and the larger-N deficit, if observed, is therefore structural at this resolution); a straddle parks it with the CIs on file for any future substrate-resolution attempt. Previously-WIN cells are re-measured at common N (not carried forward) so a regression at larger N is detectable and the 12-cell family keeps a single common N and a single family-wise error rate. No existing packet provides the N=36 measurement.
